title: Convenience
description: Spawn teleport, villager trade reset, and nether fortress compass
body:
# Convenience - Utility Commands

A simple utility plugin with 3 handy features!

## Features

### 1. Spawn Teleport
`/spawn` - Teleport to world spawn point.

### 2. Villager Trade Reset
`/transaction reset` - Reset trades of villagers within 10 blocks.
- OP only command

### 3. Nether Fortress Compass
`/nethercompass` - Get a compass pointing to the nearest fortress.
- Works only in the Nether
- Detects Blaze/Wither Skeleton locations

### Bonus
Automatically receive a fortress compass when earning the "Into the Nether" advancement!

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/spawn` | Teleport to spawn | None |
| `/transaction reset` | Reset villager trades | OP |
| `/nethercompass` | Get fortress compass | None |

## Requirements

- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+
- No dependencies
